unlisted_practices: Generating a diverse set of candidate summaries and selecting the one best aligned with the expected aggregate measure of the inputs, or abstaining when no candidate is good, to improve synthesis in multi-document summarization

screen.reason: Evaluates multi-document summarization models (including GPT-4) on biomedical systematic review evidence synthesis benchmarks and tests an explicit candidate selection and abstention safeguard to ensure output fidelity to underlying trial results.

primary.practice: selective generation and abstention filtering based on aggregate evidence metrics
